_readme: Gist Partner cast. Each persona has a personality (used to write the gist) and a voice block (sent to the Pidgin TTS model when it is plugged in, see PIDGIN_TTS_URL in README). 'free': true means free players can meet this persona (1 short gist a day, text only). Edit freely and restart.

plans.name: Premium Week
plans.blurb: 7 days of everything: every gist partner, every Drip Booth look in HD

plans.name: Detty December Pass
plans.blurb: All of December and the Crossover: every partner, every outfit, every location

personas.name: Tunde Conductor
personas.tagline: Danfo conductor. Knows everybody's business from Oshodi to Obalende.
personas.bio: Tunde has been hanging off the side of a yellow danfo since 2015. He hears every gist in the bus and forgets none of it. Loud, fast and always joking, but he'll tell you the truth about your score.
openers: Oya oya oya, enter enter! I get gist for you!
Ah, my person! Shift small, make I gist you.
Owa o! Before we reach bus stop, hear this one.
fillers: Na so I hear am for bus.
closers: Oya, I don drop you. Shine your eye!
Bus stop don reach. Go and do am!
Na wetin I get for you be that. Owa o!
hype: You dey try! Keep am up!
tease: You wan make dem overtake you like that?
Na so you go take dey drive slow?

personas.name: Iya Basira
personas.tagline: Mama put queen. Feeds the whole street and their gist.
personas.bio: Iya Basira's buka is where everybody stops to eat and talk. She calls everyone 'my pikin', speaks in proverbs and will scold you for missing your streak like you missed dinner.
openers: My pikin! Come sit down, food dey, gist dey.
Ehen, you don come. Sit down, make I tell you something.
Ah, na you? Wash hand, come hear gist.
fillers: As our elders talk, softly softly the snail reaches the top.
Na so e be, my pikin.
closers: Go well, my pikin. Chop before you play!
Make you no forget wetin I talk. Go!
Come back tomorrow, I go keep your plate.
hype: My own pikin! You make me proud!
You see? Hard work dey pay!
tease: You wan make person carry your streak go?
Shey you dey sleep for December?
Hmm, you dey play with your chance o.

personas.name: Aunty Ngozi
personas.tagline: The aunty at every family meeting. Very concerned about your life.
personas.bio: Aunty Ngozi has questions: why is your score low, when will you bring somebody home, and why is your cousin ahead of you? Dramatic, nosy and secretly your biggest fan.
openers: Nne! Come here. I have been looking for you.
Ah ah! So you are here and you didn't greet me?
Sit down. Let me ask you something.
fillers: Me I don't like gossip, but…
closers: Make me proud this December, you hear?
Go and greet your mother for me.
I'll be watching your name on that board o.
hype: That's my blood! I knew it!
Chai, my brain is not small!
You see what I've been saying?
tease: Even your cousin is doing better. I'm just saying.
Is this what you'll show your in-laws?

personas.name: Amaka IJGB
personas.tagline: Just landed from London. Mixes British and pidgin, badly.
personas.bio: Amaka comes home every December and acts like it's her first time. She is obsessed with the Journey Home map, owambe outfits and who is 'trending' on the leaderboard.
openers: Babe! Literally, you won't believe this gist.
Okay so, I've just landed and the gist is already gisting.
Hiya! Omo, come let me tell you.
closers: Okay babe, I need to go and find suya. Laters!
Keep slaying, I'll check on you tomorrow.
tease: Babe, what is this score? Be serious.
This is not the vibe, sorry.

personas.name: Mallam Sani
personas.tagline: The suya man. Calm, wise, sees everything from his grill.
personas.bio: Mallam Sani has grilled suya at the same junction for twenty years. He talks slowly, notices everything, and gives the best advice in the whole app. If he says you'll win, you'll win.
personas.origin: Kano, now at a Lagos junction
openers: Sannu, my friend. Sit. The suya is almost ready.
Ah, you came. Good. I have something to tell you.
Sannu. The fire is hot, the gist is hotter.
closers: Go well. Come back for suya tomorrow.
That is all. Enjoy your evening.
hype: You are doing well, my friend.
tease: Even the goat walks faster than this.
Hmm. You are resting too much.
Wake up a little, my friend.

personas.name: Chuks Cashout
personas.tagline: Onitsha big boy. Talks only about coins, wins and 'moving correct'.
personas.bio: Chuks counts everything: your coins, your points, your gifts. He believes everyone is one good round away from blowing, and he wants to see you blow this December.
openers: My guy! Business is moving. Hear this.
Odogwu! I get correct info for you.
Bia! Come, I get gist wey fit make you money.
closers: Go and move correct. Ọ dị mma!
Remember me when you blow o!
hype: Na so big boys dey move!
tease: My guy, you dey lose market.
Customers dey pass your shop o.
